title: Secret Stealing Attacks on Local LLM Fine-Tuning through Supply-Chain Model Code Backdoors
abstract: arXiv:2604.27426v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Local fine-tuning datasets routinely contain sensitive secrets such as API keys, personal identifiers, and financial records. Although "local offline fine-tuning" is often viewed as a privacy boundary, we reveal that compromised model code is sufficient to steal them. Current passive pretrained-weight poisoning attacks, while effective for natural language, fundamentally fail to capture such sparse high-entropy targets due to their reliance on probabilistic semantic prefixes. To bridge this gap, we identify and exploit a practical but overlooked supply-chain vector -- malicious model code camouflaged as standard architectural definitions to realize a paradigm shift from passive weight poisoning to active execution hijacking. translated_title: 通过供应链模型代码后门窃取本地大语言模型微调中机密信息的攻击
translated_abstract: 本地微调数据集中通常包含敏感机密信息，如API密钥、个人身份标识和财务记录。尽管“本地离线微调”常被视为一道隐私边界，我们揭示出被篡改的模型代码足以窃取这些机密。当前的被动预训练权重投毒攻击虽然对自然语言有效，但由于依赖概率性语义前缀，从根本上无法捕获此类稀疏的高熵目标。为弥合这一差距，我们识别并利用了一个实用但被忽视的供应链攻击向量——伪装成标准架构定义的恶意模型代码，从而实现了从被动权重投毒到主动执行劫持的范式转变。我们引入了一种确定性的全链路记忆机制：通过在线张量规则匹配锁定动态计算流中的词元级机密，并利用值-梯度解耦技术来……
tldr: 该论文揭示了一种针对本地大语言模型微调的新型供应链攻击：通过伪装成标准架构定义的恶意模型代码后门，将传统的被动权重投毒转变为主动执行劫持，利用确定性全链路记忆机制窃取微调数据中的API密钥等敏感机密信息。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a supply-chain attack on local LLM fine-tuning that uses malicious model code backdoors disguised as standard architectural definitions to shift from passive weight poisoning to active execution hijacking, employing a deterministic full-chain memorization mechanism to steal secrets such as API keys from fine-tuning datasets.
